items.title: Restriction to a localized site preserves injectives and cohomology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma has two parts: the restriction of an injective module to a localized site is injective, and the cohomology of a sheaf on the localized site agrees with its cohomology at the object (statement lines 607-617). The first part is proved through the adjunction between extension by zero and restriction together with the extension property of injectives (proof lines 619-630); the second follows by restricting an injective resolution, which stays injective by the first part (proof lines 630-638). The non-formal content is the adjunction argument in part (1). The claim is H2: one adjunction argument plus one immediate consequence.
